subject.title: Add logging and warnings for cron job execution failures

question: Should cron degradation use a dedicated minimal health route, affect the existing /readyz contract, or remain available only through authenticated diagnostics?
rationale: Job failure is not equivalent to Gateway unavailability, and the chosen HTTP semantics affect orchestration behavior, information exposure, and compatibility for existing probe consumers.

options.title: Dedicated cron probe
options.body: Add a minimal aggregate cron-health route without job metadata and keep /healthz and /readyz behavior unchanged.

options.title: Fold into readiness
options.body: Make repeated cron failures or overdue jobs fail /readyz, accepting that infrastructure may remove a functioning Gateway from service.

options.title: Diagnostics only
options.body: Keep cron health behind CLI, task audit, run history, and failure alerts without adding an HTTP component route.

recommendation.title: Dedicated cron probe
recommendation.body: Add a minimal aggregate cron-health route without job metadata and keep /healthz and /readyz behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined history across cron execution, skipped-run behavior, Gateway probes, and the issue discussion.
